messages:
drew.f: Quick question for close prepay cutoff — PREPAY-2026-045 (FinTechCo) was invoiced 2026-05-31 for $95,000 (12-month prepaid, term Jun 11 Jun 1 next year). Billing posted as recognized revenue on invoice date. We need to accrual to deferred revenue for month-end.

keisha.p: Thanks Drew. Do we have the invoice export and proof of payment?

drew.f: Attached in billing ticket. Billing treated prepay as one-time revenue because invoice date == posting date. Ticket TICK-10012 created.

arnold.s: Suggested accounting entry to reverse recognition and post deferral for full amount: 
```
Dr Service Revenue (4100)   $95,000
  Cr Deferred Revenue (2105) $95,000
```
Then amortize $7,916.67/mo Jun-May.

keisha.p: Approval threshold: I can approve operational JEs up to $100k. This is $95k so I'm good if billing ticket and payment evidence attached.

drew.f: Billing-bot: can you confirm ticket created and attach invoice export?

billing-bot: Ticket TICK-10012 created by arnold.s linking PREPAY-2026-045 and payment_receipt.pdf.

keisha.p: Approved. Please include ticket ID and invoice export in the JE support and mark JE reference JE-2026-1045. Also add a note about mid-period start handling: first recognition on Jun 1.

close-bot: Auto-note: JE must be posted before cutoff 1769011200 for May close.

drew.f: Will post JE now and update rev schedule. Tagging arnold for posting.

arnold.s: Will upload attachments and post JE, then update the close pack. Thx.
